extracted.name: Whipped Banana “Ice Cream”
extracted.description: Whipped banana “ice cream” requires only 1 ingredient: bananas! Slice, freeze, and blend bananas in a blender to make a dairy-free, creamy dessert.
instruction_lines: Place sliced bananas in an airtight container and freeze until solid, about 1 1/2 hours.
Blend frozen bananas in a blender until whipped and smooth.
